verses.1: And I saw Jehosua, the high priest, standing before the angel of the Lord. And the devil stood to his right, ready to deceive people.
verses.2: And the LORD said to the devil, “The LORD will be angry with you. The LORD will be angry with you, the chosen one in Jerusalem. This is because he has been destroyed by fire.”
verses.3: Jehoshua was dressed in fine clothes and stood before the priest.
verses.4: And he said to those who stood before him, “Remove the clothes that are covering your bodies.” He also said to them, “Look! I have removed your sins from you. Now you can be cleansed and free from your impurities.”
verses.5: And he said, “They shall put a clean crown upon his head.” They did put the clean crown upon his head. Then he was covered with clothes. And Jehovah stood there.
verses.6: And the Lord appointed Jehoash as king.
verses.7: Thus said the LORD, “If you follow my ways, and if you keep my commands, then you will also be able to judge my house. You will also protect my garden. I will give you authority over those who stand here.”
verses.8: Oh Jehovah, great priest! You and your friends who sit before you are like people in great distress. For I will bring my servant back to life.
verses.9: For behold, the stone that I gave to Joshua was placed on one of the seven stones. Now I open its lock, says the LORD, the Almighty. And I will destroy the land on that day.
verses.10: On that day, the Lord’s army will call out to each other. They will call upon one another from beneath the trees and from beneath the vines.
